$comment: Forwards every /api/* request to the deployed Spring Boot backend (Render) so the frontend keeps calling same-origin URLs — no CORS involved. Backend: https://github.com/hariomvermas/Portfolio-backend, health check: /api/contact/health. Note: Render's free tier sleeps after ~15 min idle, so the first request can take ~50 s to wake — if a contact submit fails once, retry.
